S2Q19COMM: Again, I believe that reducing real dollar expenditure on public education (K-12 system) is one of the biggest causes of Canada's high incarceration rate. It should be a priority to get class sizes down and the federal government should tie education and health funding to the Territorial Government reducing pupil-teacher ratio (PTR) to less than 13 for all school boards operating in the Territory.  I believe the Territorial Government's lack of support for public education is the primary cause of the high crime rates in our communities.
